digest.component_or_area: Jira-family adapter sub-seam for the rebar reconciler (Cloud + Data Center)
propositions: rebar cannot reconcile against self-hosted Jira Data Center, which differs from Cloud on REST v2 wiki-markup bodies, PAT bearer auth, and name-based user identity.
DC support must be an explicit shared Jira-family sub-seam rather than a forked second adapter that reaches into Cloud adapter privates and duplicates field-mapping logic.
The local-to-Jira status and priority maps are already duplicated across three copies and have drifted (only the ACLI copy omits deleted->Done), so they must be single-sourced in jira_family.
Location-pinned modules (adf.py, outbound_fields.py, comment_limits.py) must be shared by dependency inversion, not relocated, to avoid silently breaking the dynamic loader.
The DC backend must require https for base_url unless allow_insecure is set, keep certificate verification on, and read the PAT only from the JIRA_PAT env variable.

The headline acceptance is unmet: the live run scanned zero issues so it proves convergence on an empty instance, not that bidirectional reconciliation actually moves data, and known shipped defects (duplicate-issue race, identity-write deletion, key-based bindings) block closure.
